gumroad_product_copy.title: Evidence Manifest Template Pack
gumroad_product_copy.body:
Ship AI tools with confidence.

Every autonomous agent and automation workflow needs proof it handles real edge cases—the ones you discover after hours of debugging, not the happy-path examples in documentation.

This pack delivers three battle-tested JSON fixtures that let you verify your stack's behavior under actual production conditions:

1. **clean.json** — Well-formed input with all required fields present. Validates baseline operation when requirements are met.
2. **mismatch.json** — Intentionally incomplete or structurally inconsistent data. Tests whether your system detects and handles missing traces correctly.
3. **malformed.json** — Invalid structure that breaks naive parsers. Confirms robustness against malformed inputs.

+ README with usage notes explaining how to run each test, what output represents success, and how to interpret discrepancies.

Format: ZIP file containing 3 JSON fixtures + documentation (gated via Gumroad checkout)
Price: $19 USD one-time payment
Delivery: Immediate download after purchase
Refunds: Per Gumroad's standard policy

Who this is for:
- Integration leads deploying autonomous agents to production
- Product owners who need evidence before shipping AI features
- Independent builders running verification pipelines without fluff or bloat

What you'll have after using this:
- Confidence your system handles real edge cases correctly
- A reproducible test workflow you can add to CI/CD or manual validation gates
- Less time debugging production failures caused by missing trace handling

No fluff. No promises. Just verified materials you can run immediately.

product_thumbnail.style:
Clean technical aesthetic. Dark background (#0d1117 or similar). Centered terminal-like window showing a JSON code snippet with syntax highlighting (structure hint: key-value pairs, arrays visible). Green success indicators or checkmark for positive signal. Product name as overlay text in monospace font.

Key visual cues:
- Terminal/code theme (dark mode)
- Snippet of valid JSON structure (not full content)
- Professional, engineering-focused aesthetic
- No stock photos, no abstract gradients, no cartoon illustrations

profile_avatar.style:
Simple geometric logo or typography-based mark. S suggests SOJA or a minimal technical symbol (checkmark in circle, terminal prompt, code bracket). High contrast, professional, memorable at small sizes.

Recommended: Solid color background with contrasting monochrome symbol text.
Color palette options:
- Dark teal/slate on white
- Electric lime on dark gray
- Deep purple on light
